newsitem.title: USA: Red Roof Inns Q4 Dec 28 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Red Roof Inns Q4 Dec 28 net rises.

text.p: (a) Includes non-recurring charges of $10,398 ($6,215 net of income taxes) relating to the inn renewal program.
(b) Includes fourth quarter and year end non-recurring charges of $257 and $3,142, respectively ($153 and $1,873 net of income taxes) relating to a change in management.
(c) Includes Statement of Financial Accounting Standards (SFAS) No. 121 non-recurring charge of $450 ($269 net of income taxes) to recognize impairment of certain long-lived assets.

(d) Pro forma to give effect to the Offering of 10,000 shares of common stock on Jan. 31, 1996 and the application of a portion of the net proceeds therefrom to reduce certain mortgage indebtedness and related interest expense and, as noted above, to exclude the non-recurring charges relating to SFAS No. 121 and the inn renewal program in 1996, and the change in management expenses in 1995.
